Headquarters
Shanghai Municipal Police,
June 22,1927.

Confidential
Memo to Chief Inspectors etc., i/c., Districts.

No. 390
Search Parties

The following recommendations for the conduct and composition
of future search parties are forwarded for your consideration and
further discussion at the next Inspectors' Conference.

Composition          2 Foreigners
                     6 Uniform men
                     4 Chinese plain clothes men
                     Not less than a total of ten men.

Tour of Duty  Actual search duty should not last more than two
hours. This to count as four hours.

Challenging  Only suspects should be challenged. All members
of the party will halt and draw pistols when the suspect is
challenged. Searchers wearing steel jackets may however replace
pistols in holsters before starting to search.

Posters & Notices  A publicity campaign should be conducted to
persuade all classes to halt when challenged and to submit to being
searched willingly.

The various street unions should be asked to assist in the
campaign and in this way be an active assistance to authority.

Alley gates  It is considered that in close districts isolation
would be impossible in the matter of the erection of gates owing
to the danger of fire, the vast number of alleyways and the enormous
amount of supervision that would be involved.

第390号
搜查队

现提交以下关于今后搜查队的执行与组成的建议，供各位考虑，并在下一次督察会议上进一步讨论。

组成          2名外籍人员
              6名制服警员
              4名华籍便衣警员
              总人数不少于十人。

执勤时间  实际搜查任务持续时间不应超过两小时。此两小时按四小时勤务计算。

盘查  仅应对嫌疑人进行盘查。当对嫌疑人进行盘查时，全队成员应止步并拔出手枪。然而，穿着钢背心的搜查人员在开始搜查前，可将手枪插回枪套。

海报与通告  应开展宣传活动，劝说各界人士在被盘查时止步，并自愿接受搜查。

应请求各街道公会协助开展此项宣传运动，从而成为当局的积极助力。

里弄闸门  鉴于火灾危险、里弄数量庞大以及所需监管工作量巨大，在人口稠密地区，就安装闸门一事而言，实施隔离被认为是不可能的。

然而，在新建里弄以及旧有里弄中若能

霰弹枪 负责指挥的外籍人员，在具备资格的情况下，除手枪外还应携带霰弹枪，但中央、老闸和虹口分区除外。

便衣警员 穿着钢背心的便衣警员职责如下：
(1) 拦截从搜查队折返的嫌疑人。
(2) 在开枪后实施拦截。
(3) 手枪握在手中，可藏于袖内或其他地方。

费尔贝恩（Fairbain）总督察将通过中日贸易公司（China and Japan Trading Co.）安排此事。
目前由刑事侦缉处（C.I.D.）保管的背心，应移交各巡捕房督察长保管，并按其指示供侦探、搜查队等使用。

REPORT ON Functions of Search Parties

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I.Givens

Sir,

The organization and operation of street search parties first began in December 1913 when it was found necessary to adopt extraordinary measures to cope with the many cases of shooting which occurred in the Settlement. The search parties at that time comprised only one foreigner in uniform and one Chinese constable or detective in plain clothes, and one of the objects of the searches was to discover firearms on the persons or in the baggage of Chinese who were unauthorised to carry them. A second object was to discover political refugees against whom warrants were issued and countersigned by the Senior Consul, and the third object was to make evil doers realize that they would be incurring a serious risk by appearing in the streets armed. The searches were conducted at dusk and all arrangements regarding the operation of the parties were left to the discretion of the Inspector or other responsible police officers in charge. Brief reports of all searches made were forwarded to Headquarters the following day.

In December 1918 the Acting C.S.P. issued further instructions regarding the organization and operation of search parties. These instructions were briefly as follows:-

(1) Organization of Search Parties:

(a) The Inspectors in charge of districts should decide on the days of the week and hours at which the searches are to be made, the personnel and formation of the parties, their armament, dress, etc.

(b) Number of days per week should be between 2 and 4, and the

街头搜查队的组织与行动始于1913年12月，当时发现有必要采取非常措施，以应对租界内发生的众多枪击案件。当时的搜查队仅由一名穿制服的外籍人员和一名穿便衣的华籍巡捕或侦探组成，搜查的目的之一是发现无权持枪的华人身上或行李中藏有的枪支。第二个目的是发现被签发且经首席领事副署逮捕令的政治难民，第三个目的是让不法分子意识到，武装出现在街头将面临严重风险。搜查在黄昏时分进行，有关小队行动的所有安排均由负责的督察或其他主管警务官员酌情决定。所有搜查行动的简要报告于次日报送总部。

December 21, 1918.

Memo to Inspectors.

No.112.

Certain questions having recently been raised in regard
to search parties, the following memorandum is issued for the
general information and guidance of all concerned.

1. This work falls into two parts, namely, organization
and execution.

2. The organization of the work is the business of the
Inspector in charge of the district. He has to decide on
what days of the week and between what hours search parties
are to be used, of how many and of whom they are to be
composed, how and where they are to parade, how they are to
be armed and dressed and where they are to work. He may
also have to lay down general principles for the further
guidance of the men in charge of the parties.

In regard to the foregoing, the number of days per week
should never be less than two and not in ordinary circumstances
more than four. The hours should naturally be those during
which the armed robber nuisance is worst.

The number of men in a party may be three or more, of
whom at least one must be armed. Small parties have the
advantage of being less noticeable than large ones. Also,
if small parties are used, more of them can be sent out. The
man in charge must be a foreign sergeant or constable, a
special or a Sikh Havildar. The men who are to do the actual
searching must be Chinese or Sikh Constables.

The party may parade either at the Station as usual,
or (by previous arrangement) at any selected point in the
District.

The men must ordinarily be dressed in uniform.
Very occasionally or for special purposes they may be
sent out in plain clothes. Previous experience has shown
that the general use of search parties in plain clothes is
pages.zh:
1918年12月21日。

致各巡官备忘录。

第112号。

鉴于近期就搜查队提出了一些问题，现发布本备忘录，供所有相关人员知悉并作为指导。

1. 此项工作分为两部分，即组织和执行。

2. 工作的组织由负责该区的巡官负责。他必须决定在一周的哪几天以及在哪几个小时内使用搜查队，队伍由多少人组成、由哪些人组成，如何以及在何处集合，如何配备武器和着装，以及在何处开展工作。他还可能需要制定一般原则，以进一步指导各队负责人。

关于上述事项，每周的天数绝不应少于两天，在通常情况下也不应超过四天。时间自然应选择武装抢劫滋扰最严重的时段。

每队人数可为三人或更多，其中至少一人必须携带武器。小队的优势在于不如大队引人注目。此外，如果使用小队，可以派出更多队伍。负责人必须是外籍警长或警员、特别警员或锡克教哈维尔达尔（Havildar，音译）。实际执行搜查的人员必须是华捕或锡克捕。

队伍可以像往常一样在警局集合，或者（经事先安排）在区内任何选定的地点集合。

人员通常必须身着制服。在极少数情况下或出于特殊目的，他们可以便衣出动。以往经验表明，普遍使用便衣搜查队是

pages.en:
- 2 -

most inadvisable, owing to the ease with which the
situation can be exploited by small gangs of hold-up men
under the pretence that they are police.

The armed member or members of search parties
should carry pistols or revolvers, when qualified to do so,
instead of carbines.

The place of work may be indicated by streets or
localities, or by areas. The latter seems to have much
to recommend it as it gives the men in charge of
parties more scope for their own initiative. The moral
effect is equally great and the chances of actually
catching armed robbers is certainly no less.

3. The execution of the work is the business
of the men in charge of the party. He has firstly to
decide how to proceed from the Station to the place
or area appointed - whether on foot or in vehicles,
whether singly or as a party and so on. Next he has to
decide how to conduct the details of his work on arrival.
It would serve no useful purpose to lay down any hard
and fast rules on this matter as obviously such rules would
not be capable of universal application. Only the general
principle can be indicated; and this is, shortly, to get
the greatest efficiency with the least risk.

Thus as regards efficiency, the less obvious his
work is the better. Unless tied down by his instructions
he should keep his party away from well lighted places.
Search parties do not need to be seen by the public to
achieve their undoubted moral effect; the mere fact
that an average of some thousands of people are searched
nightly in the streets is sufficient to give their operations
the publicity required. Nor should he stay in one place
too long, for the reason that when once the news of the
presence of a party is carried as gossip up and down the street
by persons who have been through its hands, much of its value
pages.zh:
- 2 -

极不可取的，因为一小伙持械劫匪很容易利用这种情况，谎称自己是警察而从中渔利。

搜查队中携带武器的成员，在具备资格的情况下，应携带手枪或左轮手枪，而不是卡宾枪。

工作地点可以通过街道或地点来指示，也可以通过区域来指示。后者似乎有很多可取之处，因为它给了各队负责人更多的自主发挥空间。其道德威慑效果同样巨大，而实际抓获武装劫匪的机会肯定也不少。

3. 工作的执行由各队负责人的事务。他首先必须决定如何从警局前往指定的地点或区域——是步行还是乘车，是单独行动还是集体行动等等。其次，他必须决定到达后如何开展具体工作。就此事项制定任何死板的规定都没有什么用处，因为显然这些规定无法普遍适用。只能指明一般原则；简而言之，就是以最小的风险获得最大的效率。

因此，就效率而言，他的工作越不显眼越好。除非受指令限制，否则他应让队伍避开光线充足的地方。搜查队无需被公众看到就能产生毋庸置疑的道德威慑效果；每晚在街头搜查数千人的事实本身就足以使其行动获得所需的公开性。他也不应在一个地方停留太久，因为一旦有关于某队出现的消息通过受过检查的人之口在街头巷尾作为闲话传播开来，其大部分价值

pages.en:
- 3 -

is lost. So that, when instructions permit, a stay of
(say) 5 or 15 minutes in one place and then a quick move to
another some distance away should be aimed at.
As regards risk, the details of exactly how the
searching is to be done by the party must be left to
the man in charge. He knows what the risk is and he knows
how callous and careless men get from doing the work
night after night with no unusual incident to break the
monotony. It is his special business to guard against
this frame of mind and to keep his men on the alert.
He must also so dispose and instruct them that firstly
the search in each case is as thorough as it can be made
under the circumstances; and secondly, the best possible
protection can be given to the searchers by the armed man
or men of his party in the event of sudden aggressive action
being taken against them.

Acting Captain Supt. of Police.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

就会丧失。因此，当指令允许时，目标应是在一个地方停留（例如）5或15分钟，然后迅速转移到远处另一个地方。
关于风险，搜查具体如何进行的细节必须留给负责人决定。他知道风险所在，也知道日复一日夜间从事这项工作且无异常事件打破单调时，人们会变得多么麻木和粗心。防止这种心态并保持队员警惕是他的专门职责。他还必须如此部署和指导他们，以便首先，每次搜查在现有条件下尽可能彻底；其次，一旦遭遇突然的攻击行动，其队伍中的武装人员能为搜查者提供尽可能好的保护。

代理警务处总监。

pages.en:
Police Orders dated Nov. 7, 1918.
No. A. 1085.

The Capt. Supt. of Police again draws the attention of
Inspectors, etc.. in-charge to the need of constant care on
the part of the armed men accompanying search parties in
regard to the manner in which their weapons are carried.
It should be impressed on them that the object of their weapons
is to enable them to shoot down a desperado who draws a
pistol on the search party before he can shoot them; and to
this end they should be instructed to carry their revolvers
in a position of readiness, either hanging on the lanyard or
placed in the unbuckled holster on the belt. Similarly Sikhs
carrying carbines should have them in the hand or under the
arm and not slung on the back where they are useless in an
emergency.
pages.zh:
1918年11月7日警务命令。
A. 1085号。

警务处总监再次提请各负责巡官等注意，伴随搜查队的武装人员在携带武器的方式上需要时刻保持谨慎。应向他们强调，其武器的目的是使他们能够在亡命之徒向搜查队拔枪之前将其击毙，使其无法开枪射击搜查队员；为此，应指示他们将左轮手枪置于随时可用的位置，要么挂在挂绳上，要么放在皮带上未扣好的枪套中。同样，携带卡宾枪的锡克教徒应手持或夹在腋下，而不是背在背上，因为在紧急情况下背在背上毫无用处。

pages.en:
January 31, 1914.

Confidential.

To Inspectors, i/c. C., L., H., H., S., W.

The Capt. Supt. of Police directs that in addition
to tea houses and restaurants, the searching of lodging
houses be continued at very frequent intervals on the
lines followed heretofore. As a guide 2 or 3 should be
gone through every other night or so. The Inspector
need not be personally in charge of this, so long as
a responsible Foreigner is detailed for the work.

Regarding searching of people in the streets, the
C.S.P. directs that it be extended to ricsha coolies,
especially after midnight.

The exact addresses of all lodging houses visited
are to be recorded in the Morning State.

Deputy Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
1914年1月31日。

机密。

致C.、L.、H.、H.、S.、W.区负责巡官。

警务处总监指示，除茶馆和餐馆外，应按照迄今沿用的方式，非常频繁地继续对客栈进行搜查。作为指导，每隔一晚左右应搜查2或3家。只要指派一名负责任的外籍人员负责此项工作，巡官无需亲自指挥。

关于在街头搜查行人，警务处总监指示将其范围扩大至人力车夫，特别是在午夜之后。

所有被访客栈的确切地址须记录在《晨间状况报告》（Morning State）中。

副警务总监。

pages.en:
December 15, 1913.

Confidential Memo to Inspectors.

The many recent cases of shooting which have
occurred in the Settlement point to the necessity for
extraordinary measures being taken. For the time being
the following are deemed to be necessary :-
(1) The searching of Chinese hotels and lodging houses.
(2) The searching of suspected persons in licenced houses.
(3) The searching of suspected persons in the streets.

.............
(b) The seaching of suspected persons in the streets
will be done by parties of one Foreigner in Uniform and
one Chinese Constable or detective in plain clothes.
Particular attention must be given to the selection of both.
(c) The object of these searches are several. One is to
discover firearms on the persons or in the baggage of
Chinese who are unauthorised to possess them. Another is to
discover political refugees against whom warrants have been
issued and countersigned by the Senior Consul. For this
purpose searching parties may sometimes be accompanied
by outside informants, who will be present for identification
purposes only. A third point which is specially important
is the creation of a good moral effect. Searches must
therefore be conducted in an energetic and business-like
manner:in this way only are they likely to be useful.
The absence of any tangible result in the way of firearms,
wanted persons, etc. is of no great consequence.
(d) Searches will be conducted at night, dates and
addresses being communicated from Headquarters to Inspectors
concerned (C., L., H., WH.,W., S.,) as required. Details
of arrangements will be left entirely to Inspectors as
will also the interpretation of the phrase 'suspected
pages.zh:
1913年12月15日。

致各巡官的机密备忘录。

租界内近期发生的许多枪击案件表明，有必要采取非常措施。目前认为以下措施是必要的：
(1) 搜查中式旅馆和客栈。
(2) 搜查执照房屋内的可疑人员。
(3) 搜查街头的可疑人员。

.............
(b) 街头可疑人员的搜查将由一名身着制服的外籍人员和一名便衣华捕或侦探组成的小组进行。必须特别注意这两类人员的选择。
(c) 这些搜查的目的有多个。一是发现无权持有枪支的华人身上或行李中的枪械。二是发现已被签发并由资深领事副署逮捕令的政治难民。为此，搜查队有时可由线人陪同，线人在场仅用于辨认目的。第三个特别重要的方面是营造良好的道德威慑效果。因此，搜查必须以精力充沛和专业的方式进行：只有这样才可能有用。在缴获枪械、抓获通缉犯等方面没有任何实质性结果并无大碍。
(d) 搜查将在夜间进行，日期和地址将根据需要从总部传达给相关巡官（C.、L.、H.、WH.、W.、S.区）。安排细节将完全由巡官自行决定，“可疑
